verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents customizable notifications for recurring manual obligations such as annual penetration tests and quarterly access reviews (docs-13). It also offers reminders for assigned tasks (docs-50), overdue-task visibility (docs-9), custom fields on Tasks (docs-25) and policy-owner attributes (docs-10). That points to a task workflow with owners, due dates and recurring reminders, but nothing describes a dedicated manual-evidence workflow or expiry tracking on uploaded artifacts. missing for 10: explicit manual evidence upload workflow with per-artifact owners and due dates, expiry/renewal tracking on every manual artifact, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
